features.name: log_capital_total
features.description: Log-transformed total capital run length to compress the extremely heavy tail for linear margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smoothed monotonic signal of shouting/promotional tone, well-scaled for linear SVM.

features.name: log_capital_longest
features.description: Log-transformed longest capital run length to reduce skew.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous severity measure of sustained capitalization bursts.

features.name: log_capital_average
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized capitalization intensity for linear projection.

features.name: capital_intensity_ratio
features.description: Ratio of longest capital run to total capital run, capturing burstiness vs spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded ratio that differentiates a single big shout from many small ones.

features.name: total_word_freq_sum
features.description: Sum of all word_freq_* features representing total tracked vocabulary density.
features.expected_model_benefit: Composite magnitude useful as a normalization baseline and linear contributor.

features.name: char_freq_special_sum
features.description: Sum of all char_freq_* features representing density of special characters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures overall punctuation/symbol density which often correlates with promotional content.

features.name: high_volume_word_share
features.description: Share of frequency contributed by the top-mean word tokens (18, 20, 24, 26, 11) relative to total.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized composite of high-base-rate tokens, providing a bounded smooth signal.

features.name: dollar_exclaim_intensity
features.description: Log-scaled combination of special character frequencies often associated with promotional content (char_freq_4 = '$', char_freq_5 = '!').
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth log-transformed signal of attention-seeking punctuation for linear margin.

features.name: nonzero_word_diversity
features.description: Count of word_freq_* features that are non-zero, normalized by 48.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded diversity score; spammy messages often concentrate on fewer tokens.

features.name: char_to_word_ratio
features.description: Ratio of special character density to total word frequency density.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures stylistic skew toward symbols vs words, useful as a discriminative ratio.

features.name: extreme_capital_flag
features.description: Soft indicator combining heavy capitalization patterns via clipped log composite.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded severity score that saturates for very long capital runs.

features.name: promotional_tone_judgment
features.description: Semantic judgment score combining elevated symbol usage, sustained capital runs, and high frequency of high-base-rate marketing-like tokens into a single normalized promotional-intent score. Computed without reference to outcome labels, only row-level stylistic cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact semantic axis that linear SVM can weight directly for margin separation.
